_doc: Single source of truth for who SOMIN is: the builder turns this into the one Organization, SoftwareApplication and founder Person node every page carries (page-level copies with the same @id are replaced by these), the /about/ page and the llms.txt summary. Only facts already published on somin.ai or on the linked profiles. Prices for offers come from data/pricing.json.

organization.name: SOMIN
organization.description: SOMIN is an AI marketing-intelligence company. Its SOMONITOR platform turns verified listening data on competitor ads, posts and creators into insights, briefs, pre-scored campaign concepts and on-brand content ideas for agencies, brands and creator programs across 11+ markets in APAC, MENA and Europe.
organization.slogan: Stop guessing what works. Start knowing.
awards: Gartner Cool Vendor in Marketing AI
IMDA SMEs Go Digital Pre-Approved Solution (Singapore)

software.name: SOMIN
software.sub_category: AI marketing intelligence, competitor monitoring and campaign planning
software.description: SOMIN listens to a category (every competitor ad, post and creator on Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube) and its AI agents follow a fixed research process to turn that verified data into insights, briefs, pre-scored campaign concepts and on-brand content ideas, each traced to its source. A typical brief becomes scored ideas in about 13 minutes.
features: Brand Tracker: daily competitor ad and content intelligence across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube
Perspective Studies: persona, tension, proposition and white-space analysis
Expressions: AI-generated campaign concepts, briefs and on-brand visuals
Ad and content scoring: predictive clickability before launch
Pitch, reporting and strategy support for agencies
Creator selection and sales-focused creator briefs for creator programs
Agentic research process with traceable sources
Connects to Claude, Manus and Codex (MCP) and Zapier

founder.name: Aleks Farseev
founder.description: Prof. Aleks Farseev is the co-founder and CEO of SOMIN, a research professor in digital-marketing AI, a Forbes Technology Council columnist, and co-author of 30+ peer-reviewed papers at ACM venues including Multimedia, WSDM and The Web Conference.
